summary_en: 4,247,980 shares (48.6% of ex-treasury S/O) at ¥1,140/share. Tender offer period 26 May – 6 Jul 2026. Settlement 13 Jul 2026. Minimum acceptance 1,336,800 shares. Parent Mitsubishi Electric committed 4,485,620 shares. Kodensha to become Kinden affiliate.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Tender Offer for Shares of Kodensha Corporation (Securities Code: 1948) and Change in Affiliated Companies
translation_en_brief: Kinden Corporation announced the completion of its tender offer for Kodensha Corporation (TSE Standard, code 1948) on 6 July 2026, following a 30-business-day offer period from 26 May 2026. The tender sought 4,247,980 common shares (representing 48.6% of Kodensha's shares outstanding excluding treasury stock of 236,400 and the non-tendering commitment of 4,485,620 shares held by parent Mitsubishi Electric). The offer price was ¥1,140 per share, implying a total consideration of approximately ¥4.847 billion. The minimum acceptance threshold was 1,336,800 shares; if tendered shares fell below this level, Kinden would acquire none. Settlement is scheduled for 13 July 2026, after which Kodensha will become an affiliate of Kinden. No upper limit on shares to be acquired was set; the 4,247,980 figure represents the maximum available shares (calculated as 8,970,000 issued shares as of 31 March 2026 minus 236,400 treasury shares and 4,485,620 shares already committed by Mitsubishi Electric).
